title: PLAYER 2 IS TOLD EVERY WAVE
why: In a two player raid only the host window makes the waves, and WAVE n (with AMBUSH BEHIND YOU on an ambush) and its WAVE sting were said only there: the wave tick stops on player 2 window, and the host raid flow word carried no wave count, so player 2 was never told a wave was coming and his wave count stayed at 0 (after he took a raid over, his first wave was WAVE 1 again). Proven in a staged pair in one window: the host said WAVE 5 and player 2 said nothing with a count of 0. Now the host flow word carries the wave count and whether it was an ambush; player 2 window says the same WAVE n with the same sting when the count goes up, and takes the host count. A teammate who joins late takes the count quietly on his first word.
now: In co-op your teammate is now told WAVE and AMBUSH BEHIND YOU and hears the wave sting too.
